items.title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop for macOS and Windows
items.summary: DeepSeek now ships its agentic-coding harness as a native desktop app for macOS and Windows, moving it from a CLI-only tool to a full cross-platform product. (1 minute read)

items.title: ds4 runs LLMs locally, built by Redis's creator
items.summary: Salvatore Sanfilippo, the creator of Redis, has released ds4, a new tool for running LLMs locally. (1 minute read)

items.title: One month coding with GLM 5.3 Flash
items.summary: A developer's month of daily coding with the open-weight GLM 5.3 Flash model gives a lived-in account of the model, rather than a one-off benchmark run. (1 minute read)

items.title: ChatGPT adds a Sites feature
items.summary: ChatGPT has a new "Sites" feature, a distinct in-product surface rather than a one-off model tweak. (1 minute read)

items.title: agent-memory gives Claude Code and Codex shared memory
items.summary: agent-memory is a 2,292-star, local-first long-term memory runtime that lets Claude Code and Codex share one plain-markdown memory store with no API key required. (1 minute read)

items.title: AstaBrief, Ai2's report-generation model, is now open source
items.summary: AstaBrief, the small model Ai2 built for fast report generation inside its Asta system, is now open-weight. (1 minute read)

items.title: Janus runs GGUF models via Vulkan on AMD/Intel/Nvidia
items.summary: Janus is a single Go binary that runs GGUF models over Vulkan, working across AMD, Intel, and Nvidia GPUs without vendor-specific builds. (1 minute read)

items.title: Harvard physicist publishes 36 papers co-authored with Claude
items.summary: Harvard physicist Matthew Schwartz has published 36 papers co-authored with Claude, a concrete, attributable count of an LLM doing sustained research work rather than isolated demos. (1 minute read)
